'''Boris Ivanovich Kochelaev''' ({{langx|ru|Бори́с Ива́нович Кочела́ев}}; 19 April 1934 – 29 September 2025) was a Soviet and Russian physicist and academic.

==Life and career==
Kochelaev was born in Dirizhablestroy (now [[Dolgoprudny]]), [[Moscow Oblast]], [[Russian SFSR]], [[USSR]] on 19 April 1934. He graduated from the Physics and Mathematics Faculty of the [[Kazan Federal University|Kazan University]] in 1957. From 1957 to 1960, Kochelaev was a post-graduate student of the Experimental and Theoretical Physics Department of [[Kazan Federal University|Kazan University]] under the supervision of [[Semen Altshuler]]. He defended his [[Candidate of Sciences|candidate's]] ([[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D.]]) dissertation in 1960 at [[National University of Kharkiv|Kharkov State University]] and his [[Doctor of Sciences|doctor's]] dissertation in 1968. From 1968, Boris Kochelaev has been a [[professor]], and from 1973 to 2000, he was chair of Kazan University's [[Theoretical physics|Theoretical Physics]] Department.

He was the author of more than 150 scientific works. 33 PhD-level scientists were supervised by Kochelaev, ten of them have obtained doctoral degrees and become full professors.

Kochelaev died on 29 September 2025, at the age of 91.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ушел из жизни выдающийся физик-теоретик Борис Кочелаев |url=http://media.kpfu.ru/news/ushel-iz-zhizni-vydayuschiysya-fizik-teoretik-boris-kochelaev |access-date=1 October 2025 |website=media.kpfu.ru |language=ru}}</ref>

==Research==
The research interests are focused on [[Electron paramagnetic resonance|electron spin resonance]] and spin dynamics in condensed matter, [[superconductivity]], propagation of sound in resonant media, and light scattering in solids.

Major research achievements:
* The development of spin-phonon interactions in paramagnetic crystals:<ref>[http://www.jetp.ac.ru/cgi-bin/r/index/r/37/1/p242?a=list Contribution to the Theory of Spin-Lattice Relaxation of Nuclear Spins in Ionic Crystals B.I. Kochelaev ZhETF, 37, 242 (1959)]</ref><ref>[http://www.jetp.ac.ru/cgi-bin/r/index/r/42/5/p1303?a=list Spin-Spin Interaction via a Phonon Field in Paramagnetic Crystals L.K. Aminov, B.I. Kochelaev ZhETF, 42, 1303 (1962)]</ref>
* The non-linear theory of kinetic processes in paramagnetic crystals explained the experimentally observed phonon avalanche and super-scattering of light under saturation on the wing of the EPR line<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.jetpletters.ac.ru/ps/374/article_5912.shtml |title=B.I. Kochelaev, Yu.G. Nazarov and A.Kh. Khasanov. A light superscattering by the paramagnetic ions spin system Pis'ma ZhETF, 33, 475 (1983) |access-date=2 February 2019 |archive-date=19 February 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200219205151/http://www.jetpletters.ac.ru/ps/374/article_5912.shtml |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>[http://www.jetp.ac.ru/cgi-bin/r/index/r/42/5/p1303?a=list Spin-Spin Interaction via a Phonon Field in Paramagnetic Crystals L.K. Aminov, B.I. Kochelaev ZhETF, 42, 1303 (1962)]</ref>
* The prediction of the discovered later effect of non-resonant sound absorption and its giant amplification by radio-frequency fields <!-- Наверное, ссылка по книжке [42] -->
* The theory of EPR and spin relaxation in conventional superconductors with paramagnetic impurities<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.jetp.ac.ru/cgi-bin/r/index/e/45/4/p799?a=list |title=N.E. Alekseevskii, I.A. Garifullin, B.I. Kochelaev and E.G. Kharakhashyan. Electron paramagnetic resonance on localized magnetic states in a superconducting system La-Er. ZhETF, 72, 1523 (1977) |access-date=2 February 2019 |archive-date=10 April 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210410220105/http://jetp.ac.ru/cgi-bin/r/index/e/45/4/p799?a=list |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.jetp.ac.ru/cgi-bin/r/index/e/47/1/p75?a=list |title=A.A. Kosov and B.I. Kochelaev. Electron paramagnetic resonance of localized magnetic moments in non-gap superconductors. ZhETF, 74, 14 (1978) |access-date=2 February 2019 |archive-date=17 May 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210517120458/http://www.jetp.ac.ru/cgi-bin/r/index/e/47/1/p75?a=list |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>[http://www.jetp.ac.ru/cgi-bin/r/index/e/49/2/p291?a=list B.I. * The theory of spin kinetics and magnetic resonance in usual and high-T<sub>c</sub> [[superconductivity|superconductors]]<ref>[https://journals.aps.org/prb/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevB.61.5888 A. Shengelaya, Guo-meng Zhao, H. Keller, K.-A. Müller, B.I. Kochelaev. EPR in La<sub>1-x</sub>Ca<sub>x</sub>MnO<sub>3</sub>: Relaxation and bottleneck. Phys. Rev. B 61, 5888 (2000)]</ref><ref>[https://journals.aps.org/prl/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevLett.93.017001 A. Shengelaya, M. Bruun, B.I. Kochelaev, A. Safina, K. Conder, K.-A. Müller. Metallic phase in lightly doped La<sub>2-x</sub>Sr<sub>x</sub>CuO<sub>4</sub> observed by electron paramagnetic resonance. Phys. Rev. Lett. 93, 01 7001 (2004)]</ref> and Kondo systems with heavy fermions.<ref>[https://epjb.epj.org/articles/epjb/abs/2009/24/b090725/b090725.html Why could electron spin resonance be observed in a heavy fermion Kondo lattice? Eur. Phys. J. B. 72, 485 (2009)]</ref>

These last theoretical investigations are best described by [[Nobel Prize]] winner Prof. [[K. Alex Müller]] in the paper titled "The Impact of ESR (EPR) on the Understanding of Cuprates and Their Superconductivity":
{{quote|this important advance was achieved by the experimental results at the universities of Darmstadt and Zürich on the one side and the deep theoretical insight of Boris Kochelaev at the Kazan State University explaining them on the other side.<ref>[http://www.epr-newsletter.ethz.ch/eprnl-pdfs-free/eprn221.pdf EPR newsletter, vol.22, no.1, 5-6 (2012)]</ref>}}
